s: to lap hold of, seize, appropriate
Of mental action, to apprehend, comprehend
707300.lxx: in LXX for נָשַׂג hi., לָכַד, etc.
707300.full: κατα-λαμβάνω [in LXX for נָשַׂג hi., לָכַד, etc. ;] __1. to lap hold of, seize, appropriate: Mrk.9:18; with accusative of thing(s), 1Co.9:24, Php.3:12-13 __2. to overtake: as carrel, of διώκω (Field, Notes, 158 f.), Rom.9:30; ἡ ἡμέρα, 1Th.5:4; of evils, Jhn.1:5 12:35 (cf. 617 T); hence, to surprise, discover: Jhn.8:3-4], __3. Of mental action, to apprehend, comprehend; so mid., in NT (M, Pr., 158): Eph.3:18; before ὅτι, Act.4:13 10:34; with accusative and inf., Act.25:25 (MM, Exp., xv).† (AS)

s: to choose out, hence, to enrol
707303.full: κατα-λέγω [in LXX: Deu.19:16 (עָנָה), 2Ma.7:30 R * ;] __1. to lay down; mid. (in Hom.), to lie down. __2. to narrate (LXX, ll. with). __3. to choose out, hence, to enrol (as of soldiers, Hdt., Thuc., a1., see LS, see word): of widows, pass., 1Ti.5:9 (cf. Ellic.; CGT, in l).† (AS)

707304.lxx: in LXX far שָׁאַר (Isa.10:22 14:22), שְׁאֵרִית, etc.
707304.full: κατά-λειμμα, -τος, τό (καταλείπω), [in LXX far שָׁאַר (Isa.10:22 14:22), שְׁאֵרִית, etc. ;] a remnant: Rom.9:27, Rec. (for ὑπόλειμμα, which see).† (AS)

707305.lxx: in LXX chiefly far שָׁאַר, ni., hi., also for עָזַב, יָתַר, etc.
707305.full: κατα-λείπω [in LXX chiefly far שָׁאַר, ni., hi., also for עָזַב, יָתַר, etc. ;] __1 1, to leave behind, leave: with accusative of person(s) (of thing(s)), Mat.4:13, Mrk.12:19, 21, Luk.20:31, Act.24:27 25:14, Heb.11:27; of sailing by a place, Act.21:3; ptcp., καταλιπών, redundant (Dalman, Words, 21 f.), Mat.16:4 21:17; pass., Jhn.8:9, 1Th.3:1; metaphorically, εὐθεῖαν ὁδόν, 2Pe.2:15. __2. to forsake, abandon: Mat.19:5, Mrk.10:7" (LXX) Mrk.14:52, Luk.5:28 15:4, Act.6:2, Eph.5:31" (LXX) . __3. to leave remaining, reserve: with accusative and inf., Luk.10:40; ἐμαυτῷ, Rom.11:4 (LXX); pass., Heb.4:1 (cf. ἐν-κατα-λείπω).† (AS)

707310.full: 1. a seizing , ἐν καταλήψει within one's grasp , (Thucydides):—; an assaulting , (Aristophanes Comicus) 2. a taking possession, occupation , (Plato Philosophus), etc. (ML)

707314.full: κατ-αλλαγή, -ῆς, ἡ (καταλλάσσω), [in LXX: Isa.9:5(4), 2Ma.5:20 * ;] __1. exchange. __2. reconciliation: Rom.5:11; κ. κόσμου, Rom.11:15; διακονία τῆς κ., 2Co.5:18; λόγος τῆς κ., 2Co.5:19.† (AS)

s: to change from emnity to friendship, to reconcile
707315.full: κατ-αλλάσσω (Att.. -ττω; cf. ἀλλάσσω) [in LXX: Jer.48:39 (חָתַת), 2Ma.1:5 2Mac 7:33 2Mac 8:29 * ;] prop., to change, exchange (esp. of money); hence, of persons, to change from emnity to friendship, to reconcile (for exx. in cl., see Thayer„ LS): of the reconciliation of man to God (Lft., Notes, 288; ICC on Ro, l.with; DCG, ii, 474, 797), 2Co.5:18-19; pass Rom.5:10, 2Co.5:20; of a woman returning to her husband, 1Co.7:11 (cf. ἀπο-καταλλάσσω).† (AS)

707316.full: 1. Dep. to count up, number, reckon , (Xenophon Historicus); κ. τὸ εὐεργέτημα πρός τινα to put it down to his account , (Demosthenes Orator); καταλογιζέσθω μηδεὶς τοῦθ᾽ ὑμῖν ἐν ἀρετῇ let no one impute it to you as a virtue, (Aeschines Orator) 2. to count or reckon among , Lat. annumerare, τοὺς ἀχαρίστους ἐν τοῖς ἀδίκοις (Xenophon Historicus) (ML)

707317.lxx: in LXX for שָׁאַר, שְׁאֵרִית, יָתַר, etc.
707317.full: κατά-λοιπος, -ον [in LXX for שָׁאַר, שְׁאֵרִית, יָתַר, etc. ;] left remaining: ἱο κ. τ. ἀνθρώπων, Act.15:17 (LXX).† (AS)

707320.full: κατά-λυμα, -τος, τό (καταλύω), [in LXX: Exo.4:24 (מָלוֹן), 1Ki.9:22 (לִשְׁכָּה), etc. ;] __1. = cl. καταγώγιον (cf. πανδοχεῖον), an inn, lodgingplace: Luk.2:7 (so Ex, l.with, and MGr.). __2. a guest-room (1Sam,l.with): Mrk.14:14, Luk.22:11.† (AS)

707321.full: 1. a dissolving, dissolution of governments, (Thucydides), etc. 2. the dismissal or disbanding of a body of men, στρατιᾶς (Xenophon Historicus); εἰς κατάλυσιν till dismissal , of soldiers at a review, (Xenophon Historicus) 3. κ. τοῦ πολέμου an ending of the war, pacification , (Thucydides) 4. generally, an end, termination , (Xenophon Historicus) 5. a resting, lodging, rest , (Euripides) 6. = κατάλυμα, a resting-place, guest-chamber, quarters, lodging , καταλύσιες (ionic for -λύσεις); (Herdotus Historicus) (ML)

707323.lxx: in LXX for לוּן, שָׁבַת, etc.
707323.full: κατα-λύω [in LXX for לוּן, שָׁבַת, etc. ;] __1. to destroy, cast down: Mat.24:2, Mrk.13:2, Luk.21:6; τ. ναόν, Mat.26:61 27:40, Mrk.14:58 15:29, Act.6:14; οἰκίαν, 2Co.5:1; opposite to οἰκοδομεῖν, Gal.2:18. Metaphorical, to overthrow, annul, abrogate: Act.5:38-39; τ. ἔργον τ. θεοῦ, Rom.14:20; τ. νόμον, Mat.5:17 (2Ma.2:22). __2. to unloose, unyoke (e.g. horses), hence intrans., of travellers (cf. κατάλυμα), to take up one's quarters, lodge (cl., Gen.19:2, al.): Luk.9:12 19:7.† (AS)

s: to learn thoroughly, observe well, consider carefully
707324.lxx: in LXX: Gen.34:1 (רָאָה), Job.35:4 (5) (שׁוּר), Sir.9:5, 8, al.
707324.full: κατα-μανθάνω [in LXX: Gen.34:1 (רָאָה), Job.35:4 (5) (שׁוּר), Sir.9:5, 8, al. ;] to learn thoroughly, observe well, consider carefully (on distinction bet. κ. and μανθάνω, cf. M, Pr., 117): Mat.6:28.† (AS)

707325.full: κατα-μαρτυρέω, -ῶ [in LXX: Job.15:6, Pro.25:18 (עָנָה), al. ;] to bear witness againt: with accusative of thing(s) and genitive of person(s), Mat.26:62 27:13, Mrk.14:60.† (AS)

707326.lxx: in LXX for יָשַׁב (Num.20:1, al.), etc.
707326.full: κατα-μένω [in LXX for יָשַׁב (Num.20:1, al.), etc. ;] to remain permanently, abide: Act.1:13, 1Co.16:6, WH (παραμ-, T, EV).† (AS)

707333.full: to mix up, mingle the ingredients , (Iliad by Homer) (ML)

707338.full: κατ-αν-αλίσκω [in LXX chiefly forאָכַל ;] __1. to use up, spend. __2. to consume: of fire, ptcp., Heb.12:29 (LXX).† (AS)

s: to distribute, divide into separate bodies
707339.full: 1. to distribute, allot, assign , especially as pasture-land , (Herdotus Historicus) 2. to distribute, divide into separate bodies , (Xenophon Historicus):—;of a single person, κ. τινὰ εἰς τὴν τάξιν to assign him to his post, (Aeschines Orator) 3. Mid. or Pass. to divide among themselves , (Thucydides) 4. to occupy with cattle, to graze land , Lat. depasci, (Isocrates Orator):—;metaphorically to plunder , (Babrius Fabularum Scriptor) (ML)

s: to take note of, perceive, consider carefully
707341.lxx: in LXX for נָבַט hi., רָאָה, etc.
707341.full: κατα-νοέω, -ῶ [in LXX for נָבַט hi., רָאָה, etc. ;] to take note of, perceive, consider carefully: Act.7:31-32; with accusative of thing(s), Mat.7:3, Luk.6:41 12:24, 27 20:23, Act.11:6 27:39, Rom.4:19; with accusative of person(s), Heb.3:1 10:24, Jas.1:23-24 (on the distinction bet. κ. and νοέω simplex, see M, Pr., 117).† (AS)

707343.full: κατ-αντάω, -ῶ [in LXX: 2Ki.3:29 (חוּל), 2Ma.4:21 2Mac 4:24 2Mac 4:44 2Mac 6:14 * ;] to come to, arrive at: before εἰς, with accusative loc., Act.16:1 18:19, 24 21:7 25:13 (see M, Pr., 132) Act.27:12 28:13; before ἀντικρύ, with genitive, Act.20:15. Metaphorical, before εἰς, with accusative of person(s), 1Co.10:11 14:36; id. with accusative of thing(s), to attain to: Act.26:7, Eph.4:13, Php.3:11.† (AS)

707346.full: κατά-νυξις, -εως, ἡ (κατανύσσω, which see), [in LXX: Psa.60:3 (תַּרְעֵלָה), Isa.29:10 (תַּרְדֵּמָה)* ;] __1. a pricking. __2. (Perhaps through resembl. of κατανύσσω to -νυστάζω), torpor of mind, stupefaction: Rom.11:8 (LXX) (see ICC, in l; Field, Notes, 157).† (AS)

707347.lxx: in LXX: Gen.34:7 (עָצַב hith.), Lev.10:3, Psa.4:4, Psa 29:12, al. (דָּמַם), Dan LXX TH Sus 1:10 (רָדַם ni.), Sir.12:12 14:1, al.
707347.full: κατα-νύσσω [in LXX: Gen.34:7 (עָצַב hith.), Lev.10:3, Psa.4:4, Psa 29:12, al. (דָּמַם), Dan LXX TH Sus 1:10 (רָדַם ni.), Sir.12:12 14:1, al. ;] __1. to strike or prick violently. __2. to stun. __3. Of strong emotion, pass., to be smitten: τὴν καρδίαν, Act.2:37 (see: κατάνυξις).† (AS)

s: comb well: to tear in pieces, rend in shreds
707350.full: 1. to card or comb well: to tear in pieces, rend in shreds , (Euripides); καταξαίνειν τινὰ εἰς φοινικίδα to pound him to red rags, (Aristophanes Comicus):—;Pass., καταξανθείς crushed to atoms , (Sophocles Tragicus); πρὶν κατεξάνθαι (Euripides) 2. to wear or waste away , Lat. atterere, (Aeschulus Tragicus): Pass., κατεξάνθην πόνοις, δακρύοις (Euripides) (ML)

707353.full: κατ-αξιόω, -ῶ [in LXX: 2Ma.13:12, 3Ma.3:21 3Mac 4:11, 4Ma.18:3 * ;] to deem worthy: with accusative of person(s) and genitive of thing(s), 2Th.1:5; pass. before inf., Luk.20:35, Act.5:41.† (AS)

707359.full: 1. to besprinkle or bespatter , (Aristophanes Comicus):—;Pass., καταπαττόμενος (Aristophanes Comicus) 2. with accusative rei, to sprinkle or strew over , (Aristophanes Comicus) (ML)

s: to tread down, trample under foot
707360.lxx: in LXX for דָּרַךְ, רָמַס, שָׁאַף, etc.
707360.full: κατα-πατέω, -ῶ [in LXX for דָּרַךְ, רָמַס, שָׁאַף, etc. ;] to tread down, trample under foot: Mat.7:6, Luk.12:1; pass., Mat.5:13, Luk.8:5. Metaphorical, τ. υἱὸν τ. θεοῦ, Heb.10:29.† (AS)

s: In LXX and NT, rest, repose
707364.lxx: in LXX chiefly for מְנוּחָה, Psa.95:11, Isa.66:1, al.; ἡμέρα τῆς κ., 2Ma.15:1
707364.full: κατά-παυσις, -εως, ἡ (καταπαύω), [in LXX chiefly for מְנוּחָה, Psa.95:11, Isa.66:1, al.; ἡμέρα τῆς κ., 2Ma.15:1] __1. in cl., a putting to rest, causing to cease. __2. In LXX and NT, rest, repose: Act.7:49 (LXX), Heb.3:11, 18 4:1, 3 4:5, 10-11† (AS)

707365.lxx: in LXX for נוּחַ, שָׁבַת, etc.
707365.full: κατα-παύω [in LXX for נוּחַ, שָׁבַת, etc. ;] __1. trans., __(a) to cause to cease, restrain: Act.14:18; __(b) to cause to rest: Heb.4:8. __2. Intrans., to rest: before ἀτό, Heb.4:4 (LXX), Heb.4:10.† (AS)

s: in NT always the inner veil or curtain of the Temple
707370.lxx: in LXX chiefly for פֹּרֶכֶת (the veil of the Holy of Holies), Exo.26:31, Lev.21:23, al.; also for מָסָךְ (the outer veil), Exo.35:12, Num_3:26, al. (elsewhere κάλυμμα)
707370.full: κατα-πέτασμα, -τος, τό (= cl. παραπέτασμα) [in LXX chiefly for פֹּרֶכֶת (the veil of the Holy of Holies), Exo.26:31, Lev.21:23, al.; also for מָסָךְ (the outer veil), Exo.35:12, Num_3:26, al. (elsewhere κάλυμμα) ;] in NT always the inner veil or curtain of the Temple (or Tabernacle): Mat.27:51, Mrk.15:38, Luk.23:45, Heb.6:19 9:3; figuratively, ἡ σὰρξ αὐτοῦ Heb.10:20.† (AS)

707371.full: 1. to stick fast in the ground, plant firmly , (Iliad by Homer), etc. 2. Pass., with perfect and pluperfect active, to stand fast or firm in , (Iliad by Homer); absolute, στήλη καταπεπηγυῖα (Herdotus Historicus) (ML)

707374.full: κατα-πίνω [in LXX chiefly for בָּלַע ;] __1. to drink down, swallow: Mat.23:24, Rev.12:16. __2. to devour: 1Pe.5:8. Metaphorical, to swallow up, consume: pass., 1Co.15:54 (LXX), 2Co.2:7 5:4, Heb.11:29.† (AS)

707375.full: κατα-πίπτω [in LXX: Psa.145:14 (נָפַל), etc. ;] to fall down: Act.28:6; before εἰς, Act.26:14; ἐπί with accusative, Luk.8:6.† (AS)

707377.full: to plaster over with clay, etc., (Herdotus Historicus):—;Mid., καταπλάσσεσθαι τὴν κεφαλήν to plaster one's own head, (Herdotus Historicus); τοῦτο καταπλάσσονται ὅλον τὸ σῶμα this they plaster over their whole body, (Herdotus Historicus) (ML)

s: to strike with amazement, astound, terrify
707380.full: to strike down : metaphorically to strike with amazement, astound, terrify , (Thucydides), etc.:—;Pass. to be panic-stricken, amazed, astounded , κατεπλήγη (aorist2 ) (Iliad by Homer); attic aorist2 infinitive, καταπλαγῆναι (Thucydides); 2nd plural perfect καταπέπληχθε (Thucydides); with accusative, καταπλαγέντες τὸν Φίλιππον (Demosthenes Orator) (ML)

s: to exhaust by war, subdue completely, reduce
707382.full: to war down , i. e. to exhaust by war, subdue completely, reduce , Lat. debellare, (Thucydides): in present to attempt to subdue , (Thucydides): —;Pass., ἐλπίζοντες [ τὴν πόλιν] καταπεπολεμῆσθαι (Thucydides) (ML)

s: to wear down, oppress, treat hardly
707383.full: κατα-πονέω, -ῶ [in LXX: 2Ma.8:2 (A), 3Ma.2:2 3Mac 2:13 * ;] to wear down, oppress, treat hardly: pass., Act.7:24, 2Pe.2:7.† (AS)

s: to throw into the sea, sink or drown therein
707385.lxx: in LXX for טָבַע pu., Exo.15:4 A, בָּלַע pi., שָׁטַף, Psa.55:9 69:2, al.
707385.full: κατα-πονίζω [in LXX for טָבַע pu., Exo.15:4 A, בָּלַע pi., שָׁטַף, Psa.55:9 69:2, al. ;] to throw into the sea, sink or drown therein: Mat.14:30; pass., Mat.18:6.† (AS)

707392.full: 1. to crouch down, to lie crouching or cowering , (Homer) 2. with accusative to cower beneath , (Plutarch) (ML)

707395.full: κατ-άρα, -ας, -ἡ [in LXX chiefly for קְלָלָה ;] a curse: Gal.3:10, 13 Heb.6:8, 2Pe.2:14; opposite to εὐλογία, Jas.3:10; concrete, of Christ, Gal.3:13 (see Lft. in l).† (AS)

707396.lxx: in LXX chiefly for קָלַל pi.
707396.full: κατ-αράομαι, -ώμαι depon. (κατάρα), [in LXX chiefly for קָלַל pi. ;] to curse: with accusative, Mrk.11:21; opposite to εὐλογέω, Luk.6:26, Rom.12:14, Jas.3:9; pass. pf. ptcp., accursed, under a curse (see M, Pr., 221): Mat.25:41.† (AS)
